他的指尖沿着我脊背的弧度缓缓游走，停在泳衣系带处，若有若无地勾了一下。
“带子松了。”嗓音被海风吹得沙哑。
我咬着唇没回头，只感觉到他呼吸靠近，温热的鼻息落在颈窝：“别动，我帮你系好。”
可那双手迟迟没有动作，反倒轻轻摩挲着我颈后的肌肤。
浪声很大，盖住了我心跳的声音。他忽然凑近耳畔：“要是我不想系了呢？

His fingertips traced the curve of my back, stopping at the swimsuit strap, giving it a slight, almost imperceptible tug.
“The strap is loose.” His voice was hoarse from the sea breeze.
I bit my lip, not turning around, only feeling his breath close, his warm breath on the crook of my neck: “Don't move, I'll tie it for you.”
But his hands didn't move, instead gently caressing the skin on the back of my neck.
The sound of the waves was loud, drowning out the sound of my heartbeat. He suddenly leaned close to my ear: “What if I don't want to tie it?”
